reason: Instagram already does the job for my flyers and my student crowd lives there, and this app has no users yet. I'm not committing to a 3-month minimum for something nobody has opened.
objection: The app isn't public, so there's no audience. Why would I pay for a map spot when nobody is looking at it, on top of a 3-month minimum?
would_change_my_mind: Seeing real numbers: students in my city actually using the app, and a few venues like mine who got people through the door from it. Or no minimum commitment while it proves itself.
